notes.title: Work Continues.. Planned Release Timeline.
notes.content:
Hello all!

Work continues on the remake, and we make great progress.

Below you will find some screenshots taken while testing AI and their movement. 

While there isn't enough to justify a devlog I would like to talk about the planned release date and stages.

NOVEMBER: Initial Release

 Re-enter early access stage of development. 
 Early story line, and basic game play elements. 
 Mostly used to bug fix, improve audio and work on Fort Building mechanic. 


DECEMBER: Planned

 We aim to have the basic Fort Building Mechanic done. 
 Audio mostly completed. 
 Bug fixing. 


JANUARY: Completion

 We aim to have a completed story and most kinks ironed out. 
 Depending on feedback and interaction, we may add multiplayer. However, at this point we are striving for a fun single player experience. 


We look forward to showing more and hearing back from you. Feel free to reach out below or in the discussions!

notes.title: Hello! (Repost)
notes.content:
While working on another project, I decided not to give up on They are hundreds. 

During march of 2018, I made a commitment to build and finish a game This being They are hundreds. One thing ran to another, I ran out of time and have to work a lot, thus losing motivation and building a game with no focus or narrative.  

Frankly, there still is no story-but TAH was never supposed to be a survival game, it started out as a round based zombie game with terrible graphics and no experience on making games. I have learned a lot over the last year, I still work a lot and won't be able to push updates out all that frequently but I plan on announcing a road map on the discord. Here:  https://discord.gg/HNQ8PDK

The update you have received today is a co-op (4 players) wave based game-mode, back to TAHs roots. I won't lie too you, its not really ready to release. I have released it to test its multiplayer functions as I cannot really do it myself. So bugs are most welcome! 

The community has grown so much, and I cannot wait till i can push the game out of EA, with a satisfactory game. Look out for the road map, and thanks for sticking around! The store page will be updated tomorrow night.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/79ef683657e0832cb54b265f2b54fc8fe726a7e0.jpg

Yeah it started as that ːsteamfacepalmː

notes.title: Patch & Price Change! Crafting & More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I actually can't believe I was able to post this update. Last night when the patch was ready to be posted, my main HDD died thus I thought the files of the game were gone. I was able to recover the files, and game files and with that I give you this!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/b10ecd5f6f07cc2d2f4cbe4405c79308567898c7.jpg

 Main Changes 

- Time of day speed 5x faster. 
- Start with pistol, ammo, and food. 
- Chests now only contain food, beds, ammo with the only firearm being a pistol. **More on this later**
- There is a new crawler zombie, slow but more shots are required!
- New hell hound, Fast, and hard to kill. 
- AI FOV lowered. 
- Crafting??
- Removal of most firearms on the map, only one m4 and shotgun can be found. 
- Camp fires now give more light. 
- Armor (Testing) reduces damage taken from firearms. 
- Performance changes. 
- Main menu camera replacement

Crafting

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/309d097b59ba74dde28ffe393612e56bbb41a71d.jpg

No longer will you search endlessly for those pesky bullets! 

If you hover over the item you desire to craft, it will tell you what is required.
For example, the shotgun and m4 will require Iron bars. You must first craft iron bars, then the weapon. Why? Doing this adds more depth to the game, and hopefully will extend life time. 

FAQ - Can i still find weapons without crafting? Yes pistols, and one m4 and shotgun. 

I cannot find a pickaxe laying around, what do I do! You can find them in the chests located around the map. 

It is dark! You can access a flashlight completely free in the crafting menu!

The Crawler

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/9c1cf72149bb1d1fd8003c0632f308f0fc05dae0.jpg


Takes only 3 shots to kill, while not that strong they are sneaky!

 The hound

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/76339a77038c58014dbcb63df72f353277a7d968.jpg

These are fast, and tough creatures. No one knows where it came from, but it will empty your pockets of ammo!

 Price change 

Why are you raising the price, and by how much?

I would firstly like to thank everyone who have joined the community, with the 0.99 price tag I had hoped to grow the community and it did! So welcome! 

I am raising the price by 0.99 = 1.99 by the end of the month. Why?
I work a full time job, and with the extra income I could effectively triple the patch count by taking time off of work. 

For example, this patch took me exactly 12.30 Hours. Obviously recovering the data took up some time which is included. I did most of the patch in my one day off. So if i took one, or two more days off a week or even month I could increase the productivity of patches. 

I am still considering this move, however for transparency I have decided to share the idea. I welcome your opinion. 

 There have been a lot of questions about the save system, so i will be making a YouTube video covering the topic shortly. 

Thank you all for your continued support, I read all of the reviews and am truly grateful. 

- Jake

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/15fd403eed46dd10964f81669c41074fa2603e1c.jpg

notes.title: April 24th patch + survey
notes.content:
Hello everyone, ever since the price drop the community has grown a lot! I wish to thank everyone for their interest in They Are Hundreds, the past few months have been a blast!

Tomorrow's patch.


    Huge Graphical improvements. 
    New options menu
    New option settings, should help with those who cannot run the game well.
    You can now edit the gravity in the game.
    You can now edit your walk speed in the game.
    Upcoming feature within context of prior
- Select if you want infinite ammo
- Select if you want infinite money
- change zombie spawn speed's + how many will spawn.
    New map, this is not easy to run however.
    3 Types of zombies currently. 
- HordeZombies (Only on protect objective map) Will go only for objective untill complete. Follows same damage path as others.
- Sprinters ( All but objective map ) Fast as $%#@, but be careful they take two shots to kill!
- Walkers ( All maps but objective ) Simple walkers, spawn is mass die in mass. One shot to kill.
    Glock now has a flashlight.
    New map has Day/night cycle.
- Eventually you will need a campfire, and zombies will be faster at night.
    New ammo gathering rate, each kill gives you a surplus amount of ammo for Assault rifle.
    New loading screen ( User requested ) I am still changing how it looks I did post a mock up of it in a prior announcement. 
    From six to 3 maps, why? 
- I'm tired of poor quality, I want to put more time into my product to insure it looks better.
    3 Game modes
- Free roam
- Wave linear
- Protect Objective. 
    New running sound with glock. Temporary sound attached to it for now.
    Building system reworked, should now work with no problems please leave post if it does not.
    New HUD in game, I believe it looks better.
    Turret shooting sound is now fixed. You can only hear the shot if within the radius the sound travels.
     Doors, if you hit them they will open. Only on new map currently.
     Removed buggy to rework how it works. 
      BIGGEST  new shooting mechanic, no longer will you shoot endlessly without hitting the zombie. I have tested this new mechanic for 2 hours straight and it works 100%.
    I have the new zombie mechanic done, however please comment below if you want this feature.
- If they see you within 1500m they will chase you, if not they will idle.
Do you want this feature?
    Sprinting speed increased while using glock.
    Let's talk multiplayer.
The multiplayer as we all know, has been far from perfect. I understand the frustration and as this is my first game using multiplayer I was just happy to see it work somewhat, however I am working on a gamesparks server implementation to make the multiplayer better. However I have not done this before and it will take time. 

Survey 
Should I make update video's, or continue to write these? Which do you prefer. 


Take a look back. This is what the game used to look like, maybe 3-5 weeks ago.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/07aa2b4a0b2047b41ca5f320d29c8eaa90339fea.jpg

Too now.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/591b1d36f838783db9861e3dd3f8261e910dc610.jpg

I have been called a scammer, a thief and so on. I do not have any interest in scamming anyone, this is my project and I find the up-most joy in posting these patches and seeing the improvement. I hope you all have an amazing day, and I welcome all of you who are new to They Are hundreds.

- Please excuse any spelling error's within this post, as I am pretty sick and about on E.

notes.title: Objective Guarding, Fully Automatic and more.
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/15fd403eed46dd10964f81669c41074fa2603e1c.jpg

 Sorry for the delay everyone, I had issues to deal with and it got in the way. 

Just a small patch adding a new map, and gamemode. The game now has 3 gamemodes, and just over 5 maps. I think for now, I am done with new maps and will focus on improving the existing maps, features etc as well as adding controller support however I do not guarantee that it will be featured in the next patch. 

And now for the patch notes :)


    New map
    New Gamemode
    Game now features 6 maps.
    XM8 now is fully automatic
    Not really a patch note, however. If you have any idea's on how to gain 556, within reason i'd be interested. While playing myself I find I run out quickly. Now with the fully automatic I was toast. (Comment Below)
    Horde zombie, this is featured on the new map and gamemode. I have new zombie character, and animations in the works. However my skills don't fall in this category. 
    Horde zombie boasts lower spawn rates, however in later rounds it will increase.
    Achievement for the secret on Prison map was fixed, if you run into the object you will get this achievement. Not telling you what though. It should be somewhat obvious :)


 I know it's a small patch, I have a lot going on but I will always continue to post patches. As always, I am always open to suggestions, and feedback. Feel free to add me if you have any, or post them in the discussions. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Bug Squash, new map and more.
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/15fd403eed46dd10964f81669c41074fa2603e1c.jpg

Hello everyone after a long few hours of trying to figure out why you would freeze on entry to a map, I have solved the issue. 

 Performance, bugs, etc. 


    Hounds are now 5 hits to kill, and drop fifteen 556 rounds. Spawn amount also is smaller increasing FPS. User Requested.
    Removed smoke, and fire from hunger box. Increase to FPS.
    Removed freeze glitch after leaving, and going into another map. Finally. 
    Hit box improvements. Bullet spawns closer to barrel of weapon. User requested. 
    Multiplayer, when you join you should be able to access options without the main menu showing up.
    Removed the 1 second delay when switching weapons. User requested.
    Buy menu improvements.
    Frame-rate should be higher on all maps, do to the hunger box fix.

 Content Additions 

    Pretty prison, new map found in singleplayer
    A few achievements. More coming soon. User requested.
    Armor now is more useful doubled the damage it can withhold. User requested.
    Note - EA achievement can only be earned while game is in EA. Giveaway but hey :)
    The about section changes
    Collection, placement, and building all are now FIXED or should be. I tested it, but was only for a few minutes as I was already past deadline.


Just a small patch to push the game along, I love seeing people talk to me about the game. So if you have feedback or just wanna talk about the game feel free to add me. Also, if you had posted bugs and they were not in this patch, don't worry I have taken note of all the bug everyone has mentioned and continue to work on them. I had set a pretty strict time limit for this patch, and I blew past it.

Thanks everyone for the dedication to the game, starting this project I never thought it would pick up this quickly. Have a good night!

notes.title: XM8, Prison from hell SteamVR fix much more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/f2e0d64a6592b38a986dc78aa1cebfb3d0bac647.jpg

Hello everyone, firstly i'd like to say goodbye to the whole Friday only patch thing. I can't seem to keep my fingers off of a keyboard, let's take a look at the patch notes. 
 Performance

    The SteamVR bug should now be fixed, if not please let me know.
    No longer freezes on map entry, from my experience It should now be fixed.
    Green screen, if you get this bug please change your resolution from 1920 to something different and change it back. Only if you get it, it should now also be fixed.


 The cool stuff.

    Added XM8, new special ammo type. You can get this ammo by killing zombies with your Glock. Each kill gives you 3 bullets.
    Glock now holsters 17 bullets with a new starting count of 170 in reserve.
    New Map, Prison from hell. It's early with navigation mapping so zombies might fly out of the map, sorry haha it was 5 am.
    New 556 ammo type.
    New HUD display, you can hide this by pressing "G"
    Ragdoll now lasts longer.
    Now when you kill a zombie there is no longer an invisible wall which will damage, or block you.
    Zombie hitbox models have changed, they should be better.
    New default multiplayer map is Prison, you can do a survival map by pressing The check box "Death Mode" it will lead you to the second map in single player.
    I forgot to fix the ping counter, I wrote it down but forgot.
    New running animation
    You can switch weapons with the scroll wheel (Scroll down)


Ah, My favorite quote.
 I forgot
I spent the last 9 hours doing things on this project, and I did not write each thing down as I did them. Believe me this is a huge patch, and I put a lot of effort into it. I hope you will find some fun within it. And as always please post bugs in discussions or add me. Have a good one! ːsteammockingː


PS. This was written at 6 15 am, there may be grammatical or dumb things inside this. notes.title: Patch notes for this Fridays "Hidden Gem"
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/15fd403eed46dd10964f81669c41074fa2603e1c.jpg
They Are Hundreds Patch Notes.

This patch opens the door, and allows for the expandable weapon base that is coming in the future line up. Thew new weapon this Friday, is the "Hidden Gem"
 Into the Changes.
        
        [+] Glock 18
        [+] New ammo, no longer unlimited in it's supply.
        [+] New player model. 
        [+] Gun's now feature animations
        [+] New firearm sounds
        [+] Zombies now give less money
        [+] Trees now give less resources.
        [+] Rocks now give less resources.
        [+] Zombies rag doll effect is now effected by the bullet, and will be dynamic.
        [+] You can now ADS in firearms. 
        [+] New Running animation

=============================================
That should do it for the patch notes. I just want to say thank you for everyone who supports this project. It's truly means a lot, and I will continue to update the game.

-  Jake

 NOTE: I work alone, I will miss small bugs that are not obvious so if you find one, please let me know in the discussions. There will now be a patch every Friday.

From now on, in order to allow people to build without losing their bases i'm switching to weekly update. These updates will be bigger, with more content. Also, share you base screenshots on the community hub and if they're cool i'll add you and give you a key for a friend so they can be even bigger! Have a good one everyone, and Thank you!

    Singleplayer Maps, three for now.
- I'm going to update these maps with more detail when I have time, I've been working a lot so I haven't had as much time as I'd like to put into them.
- Each map is detailed for High end, to low end pc's so everyone can get decent FPS.
    Adjusted Spawn count on wave one to 90, from 150.
    Hounds now take 20 shots, not 25.
    Buggies are now included in each map.


Just a small patch to push more content before launch.
- Jake

notes.title: Huge Update + Release date and price!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
On February the 26th our game was accepted, and we're now able to release.
Let's take a look at a few things,


    Release date March 13 2018, this will be early access release.

    Price point, we value and price our games on how many hours they hold.

    Our current fair price we value to be 2.99-3.99 as some features are not in.
   
    What's going to be in the game build on release?


 In the current build of the game, we have building, multiplayer, single player,
 building saving, turrets, horde system, 2 variations of zombies, hunger system,
and new in game pause menu.

What's in the next patch?

Next patch drops March 2, at 5 pm EST.

Change log, 


    New fog in Main map.
    Can now show FPS by click "N"
    New Main menu, and pause menu.
    More zombies in first horde
    Multiplayer bug squash, still not 100%
    Now you can build a light for your house, free of course.
    Now start with 5 turrets, until I fix the save system for everything.


Much more coming, I have been very busy thanks all!

notes.title: v0.53 Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, in this patch we just fixed some minor bugs with v0.53. Here is what we fixed!

+ Multiplayer map selection, you can now use the Arena map only in multiplayer.
+ Fixed the Building save system, we're still working on the save system for stats, such as health wood count, stone count, etc.
+ Fixed the shop button
+ Fixed the Escape button, now after pressed it will wait two seconds to save all buildings then move you to the main menu.
+ Performance bug fixes. 
-------------------
Thanks everyone.

notes.title: Huge update Patch #.53
notes.content:
Hello everyone, in the patch v0.53 here is what changed!

+ New building mechanic 
+ Resource gathering, Trees, rocks.
+ New hunger system, you have to search for food crates in the dead zone.
+ Multiplayer Bug fixes (Still in early alpha)
+ New food option in the Buy menu
+ New Mob
+ Map lighting is different.

Removal of these
- Arena mode, it was kinda useless and not needed.
- Removed the 1,2,3,4 building system now host's a menu, instead. 
- Removed Building parts, now have resources trees, and rocks.

Problems with patch
-  I broke the escape button in this patch, to exit you'll have to alt+F4 sorry.
 


Next patch thoughts

+ New map
+ Dedicated Multiplayer servers
+ Lowered ping
+ Dynamic AI fixes
+ Fixing the ESC button (I broke it)
